description: The automatic processing of the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake (M7.5, 2024-01-01) produced a preliminary hypocenter with RMS travel-time residuals exceeding 1.5 seconds at multiple stations, indicating poor automatic phase timing. You are the duty seismologist responsible for manual event review. Open the event in scolv's waveform picker, manually re-pick the P-wave first arrivals on all three stations that have recorded waveforms (GE.GSI, GE.BKB, GE.SANI) by clicking precisely at the first-motion onset of the P wave on each seismogram trace. After improving the picks, trigger a relocation to compute a new hypocenter using the improved timing. Review that the residuals have improved, then commit the manual solution to the database. The final solution must be saved with evaluation mode set to 'manual'.
